name: module-listener-decl-test-9b9489d763/module-listener-declaration-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: "Module variable declarations" and "Class definition"
reason: The case asserts rejection of module listener declarations whose inferred union includes a non-listener class, and of explicit or inferred Listener2 declarations because Listener2 lacks attach. Module listener declarations and class definitions are explicitly supported; the service object parameter qualifier, defaultable method parameter, constructors and error return are covered and do not invoke a restriction. Invalid listener types are negative checks within the supported declaration/type system.
test_design_notes: Three declarations carry @error markers; the initial union-typed module variable supplies the type for the first negative assertion.
